channel.title: Alex Rozgo: writing
channel.description: Articles on simulation, AI agents and virtual worlds by Alex Rozgo.

item.title: Maquina: A Theory of Everything for Digital Twins
item.description: Proposes modeling digital twins with three primitives: objects, operations and machines. The idea became the Maquina project.

item.title: Making the Case for Nash Equilibrium as a Measurement Tool for Virtual Worlds
item.description: Argues for measuring how far a virtual world is from equilibrium instead of designing for perfect balance.

item.title: Situational Complexity in Massive Simulations
item.description: Describes Situation Design: areas of activity with a radius of influence, role slots and growth rules, placed above agents and encounters.

item.title: Meaning and Memory in Massive Simulations
item.description: Proposes designing worlds from meanings such as “resting place” and storing memory in places and objects as well as in NPCs.

item.title: ModernBERT in Game Development
item.description: Where a small encoder model fits in games: classifying player behavior, game state and procedural content.

item.title: Advanced AI Architectures for Immersive Virtual Worlds
item.description: Actor model, behavior trees, memory systems and language models for agents in virtual worlds.
